scoring_justification: T1 recompute of P6_3 GGA band gap from p6_3_band_structure.json; other gaps and hybrid gap are verified against paper references (T0). Phonon stability is audited by inspecting p6_3_phonon_dispersion.json for negative frequencies.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for band gaps and stability flags
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper table/figures and HSE06 reference from the paper's discussion
hidden_assets.generation_method: Numbers taken from the paper: P6_3 GGA gap = 0.823 eV, P-3c1 and P6_3cm GGA gaps ~0.013 eV, P6_3/mmc metallic (gap 0), HSE06 hybrid gap = 1.55 eV (cited Ref [16]). Stability conclusion: only P6_3 is dynamically stable.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported values, used as hidden gold for comparison.

required.kpoints: list of lists of 3 floats (k-path coordinates)
required.eigenvalues: list of lists of floats; eigenvalues[i] are the band energies (in eV) for kpoints[i]

outputs.description: Raw GGA-PBE band structure of the P6_3 phase along the standard high-symmetry path. The checker recomputes the minimum indirect band gap from these eigenvalues.

required.phases: array of objects, each with name (string), band_gap_GGA (float, eV), dynamically_stable (bool)

outputs.description: Reported GGA band gaps for all four phases, hybrid gap for P6_3, and static stability flags (filled after phonon step). The checker compares the GGA gaps and the hybrid gap to hidden reference values within tolerances.

required.frequencies: list of lists of floats; frequencies[i] are the phonon mode frequencies (in meV or cm-1) for qpoints[i]

outputs.description: Phonon dispersion of the P6_3 phase. The checker inspects this file for the absence of negative (imaginary) frequencies to confirm dynamical stability.

output_contract.notes: The agent must run all the DFT+phonon workflow and produce the three scored artifacts. The checker will recompute the band gap from the raw band structure, compare reported gaps to paper reference values, and audit phonon frequencies for imaginary modes.

steps.description: Compare agent-reported P6_3 GGA band gap to paper's 0.823 eV within ±0.05 eV.
Recompute the minimum indirect band gap from the raw P6_3 eigenvalues (assuming Fermi level at 0 eV); compare to paper's 0.823 eV within ±0.05 eV.
Compare agent-reported hybrid (HSE06) gap for P6_3 to 1.55 eV within ±0.2 eV.

Ensure that the GGA gaps for the other three phases (P6_3/mmc, P-3c1, P6_3cm) are very small (< 0.05 eV, consistent with metallic/tiny-gap behavior) and that P6_3 has the largest gap among all four phases.
Audit the P6_3 phonon dispersion: all frequencies must be non-negative (≥ -1e-4) to confirm dynamical stability.
Cross-check stability flags: P6_3 dynamically_stable must be true; the other three phases must be false.
